fact: The NBE presentation states the bank acts as regulator, overseer, supervisor and owner-operator of the payment system, issued PII and PSO directives in 2020, gave the first non-bank mobile money licence to Ethiotelecom in 2021 and licensed M-Pesa in 2023, and that the national switch provides interoperability.
title: Ethiopian Payment System Landscape
publisher: National Bank of Ethiopia (ITU-T DFS webinar)
